questions.stem: Two forces of 3 N and 4 N act at right angles to each other. What is the magnitude of the resultant force?
questions.explanation: Using Pythagoras' theorem: R = sqrt(3² + 4²) = sqrt(9 + 16) = sqrt(25) = 5 N. You cannot simply add the magnitudes when vectors are perpendicular.

questions.stem: A force of 10 N acts to the right and a force of 6 N acts to the left on the same object. What is the resultant force?
questions.explanation: When vectors act in opposite directions, the resultant is found by subtracting: 10 - 6 = 4 N. The direction is to the right because the larger force acts to the right.
